accepted.reason: The authorized direct-process boundary accepts a caller-selected executable and separately validated argv, copies only four spawn options, forces shell false at the final child_process call, and has a behavior test proving shell metacharacters are not evaluated; CodeQL 2.26.0 still classifies the environment-derived executable path as a shell-command sink.

The two findings cover lstat-then-read checks of a maintainer-controlled acceptance JSON file and candidate tarball in a clean, same-user repository. A process able to replace either file can already edit the tracked source, package candidate, and acceptance record directly; the reads disclose no content and grant no additional authority. Replace them with descriptor-based no-follow reads in the next separately owner-tested package release.
